<div class="card-body">
'''Brainiac''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊ブレイニアック</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊戦闘力＝√3（X－Y）＋2（A－B）＋π（最低でも戦闘力＝1）。X＝ダークサイドの手札の枚数、Y＝ライトサイドの手札の枚数、A＝場に出ているカードのダークアイコンの合計数、B＝場に出ているカードのライトアイコンの合計数、π＝3.141592653589793238462643383...である。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Brainiac-PSA-156625019.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ボシェックはこのシニティーンの男性に“ブレイニアック（頭でっかち）”というあだ名をつけた。その名にふさわしく、彼はハイパースペースの座標を自分の頭で計算できる。レイアの脱獄作戦も、彼が立案していたらさぞかし・・・</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Brainiac.

'''Card text:'''
*Power = √3(X-Y)+2(A-B)+π (minimum power = 1).
X = Dark Side cards in hand.
Y = Light Side cards in hand.
A = total Dark icons in play.
B = total Light icons in play.
π = 3.141592653589793238462643383...

'''Lore:'''
BoShek nicknamed this male Siniteen "Brainiac" (big-headed). True to the name, he can calculate hyperspace coordinates in his head. If he had planned Leia's jailbreak, surely...

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese lore wonders what if he had planned Leia's jailbreak; the English quotes BoShek.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Brainiac]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
